blocks.orig: Mto wa Mbu is a village close to Lake Manyara National Park, where it stands out as a green oasis in the middle of the surrounding Maasai plains. Get a taste of culture and discover this lovely little village, the surrounding lush green nature, and the banana plantations by hopping on a mountainbike. Then get off your bike to visit a nearby Maasai village, where some Maasai tribesmen tell you all about their way of life.
blocks.html: Close to Lake Manyara National Park lies the village of Mto wa Mbu, a green oasis that stands out among the Maasai plains around it. Jump on a mountainbike for a taste of local culture as you explore this pleasant small village, the lush green countryside around it and the banana plantations. Afterwards you leave your bike behind and visit a Maasai village nearby, where Maasai tribesmen tell you all about how they live.

blocks.orig: Suitable for all fitness levels as it’s on flat terrain
blocks.html: The terrain is flat, so it’s suitable for every fitness level
